_doc: TANG 2 — BANG TEM NHAT → SIZE (giay chay, cot size theo he adidas nac 1/3). Chep nguyen so lieu tu Sales Desk size_chart.js FOOT_TABLE (01/09/2026), truoc do nam dang chu trong agent.json/bang_size. `tem` = so cm in tren tem/luoi giay (JP); `daiChanCm` = dai ban chan ung voi tem do (giay chay: tem = dai chan + 1,5cm); `rongChanCm` = [min, max]. Khach doc 'size 265' / 'size 26,5' / 'size 28' tran = tra THANG cot tem, KHONG cong them.

tuVan._doc: 05/10/2026 (phieu Desk nhom so do: 26/09 xin du 3 thong so, 06/09 so do khong go cm). TANG 2 cua co che 'size tu so do khach' (ma tang 1: packages/brain/src/engine/size-advisor.ts). `soDo` = cac so do khach co the noi: `nhan` = chu dung truoc con so (da bo dau), `donVi` = don vi → he so doi ra don vi cua cot, `khoang` = khoang hop ly (ngoai khoang = khong phai so do nay), `khongDonVi` = khach go thieu don vi van nhan ('chan be 25.5'), `macDinh` = so co don vi ma khong co chu nhan thi coi la so do nay. Kieu: `moc` (cot 1 so: lay hang dau tien >= so do, tuc lam tron LEN), `dai` (cot [min,max]: hang dau tien chua so do), `vungDem` (cot [min,max]: chi so voi dai CUA hang so do chinh chon — trong dai = chuan, vuot = len/lui). `rongTu`/`doLaiTu` = lech tu bao nhieu nac thi goi y ban wide / nhac do lai. `he` = cac he quy doi cua nganh, he dau tien `khi` khop ngu canh (loi khach + mau dang noi) duoc dung; `can` = so do bat buoc truoc khi duoc neu size (so do dau la so do chinh); `dich` = cong vao so do chinh truoc khi tra [thap, cao] (giay chay: tem = dai + 1,5cm = dung cot daiChanCm; giay san tem = dai + 0,5..1,0cm = dich -1,0..-0,5; giay pho tem = dai + 0,5cm = dich -1,0). Luat nganh chot 26/09: BO cong nua size vi chay dai, BO ti le 'chu vi − rong'; chu vi co VUNG DEM = dai chu vi cua size theo dai. `heMacDinh` rong = chua ro he thi chap nhan dap an cua moi he, khong neu size nao. `bangCuaHang` = hang co nhan size CHINH LA cot size cua bang nay (he adidas); hang khac lay bang hang tu landing (cong cu variant.brandChart), hang khong co bang thi KHONG quy ra nhan size.
